title: Amazon staff to strike and rally on busiest weekend of the year
summary: Amazon employees around the world are set to stage protests on Black Friday amid claims of unfair pay and oppressive working conditions.
caption: A Make Amazon Pay demonstration in Leipzig in 2022. Pic: AP

title: Kenyan cult leader in jail for 191 murders convicted over another 123 deaths
summary: A Kenyan cult leader has been convicted of manslaughter over the deaths of 123 of his followers, having already been found guilty of murdering 191 others.
caption: Paul Mackenzie. Pic: Reuters
